podcast.body: A Toto song that Weezer initially covered after a fan's request for "Africa." This cover was released as a response to Mary Kinchen's tweet, before the band eventually recorded "Africa." "That, however, was not the end of it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rivers Cuomo and Weezer - Alt-Rock's Nerd Heroes Part 2

podcast.body: In mid-May 2018, Weezer unexpectedly released a cover of Toto's "Rosanna." This release was perceived as a playful response or "troll" to an ongoing Twitter campaign by a fan, Mary Klym, asking Weezer to cover Toto's "Africa." "But then suddenly in mid-May 2018, Weezer dropped a total cover online. It wasn't Africa, but it was Rosanna, the other big single from that same total album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
